verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no public API or spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The Gusto integration and Excel exports are adjacent features, not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
